text:
maria: Kicking off 'Lapwing' playbook for observability alpha. Goal: ship a lean console surface for dashboards + tracing hooks + cost & error analytics to two pilot customers by end of Q2. Need scope, owners, and launch criteria.
kevin: Quick q — who are the pilot customers? prod traffic or staging only?
jess: Acme (prod) + HealthCo (staging→prod in a month). Acme wants per-route cost visibility, HealthCo cares about error-slice alerts.
tara: From SRE: we need to agree sampling and SLOs up front. If we trace everything we'll blow budget. Propose default sample=1% global, and sampled-on-error=100%.
oliver: I'll mock a single 'EyesOn' dashboard template (one page) with: latency heatmap, 95/99 latency, cost per endpoint, error rate by model, top error traces. Keeping it single-pane helps adoption.
kevin: Implementation notes: add span tags model.name, route.id, tenant.id. Expose a small hook in the runtime to emit minimal trace metadata to the telemetry pipeline. Sampling controlled by header X-Redwood-Sample or feature flag. Example snippet:```python
def trace_request(req):
    tags = { 'model': req.model, 'route': req.route_id, 'tenant': req.tenant }
    if should_sample(req):
        start_span('request', tags=tags)
```
maria: @kevin @tara can you list what runtime + gateway PRs look like (roughly)? also need perf budget for tracing (target <1% overhead).
kevin: Runtime: 1) small hook to emit trace metadata, 2) opt-in header handling, 3) batching to telemetry producer to avoid extra RPCs. Gateway: add route-level sampling config + flag. Estimate: 2-3 sprints of focused work (shared infra).
tara: I'll write a canary plan: enable for 1% of traffic on a non-critical region, monitor 95th p90 latency and error spike. Rollback if latency delta >2% or error spike >0.5pp.
eva: One ML note: we should tag decode spans with token counts and quantization mode so cost attribution is accurate. Suggest adding token_count to spans.
jess: Customer asks to support per-request cost estimate in UI and exportable rollups for billing. Also they want alerting on error slices (example: >5% error for a model.route for 10m).
kevin: Tradeoffs: full-trace capture for all requests = clarity but +infra cost. Plan: capture full traces for errors and sampled traces for success, and run post-process to attribute cost per route from token_count + model profile.
maria: Proposed MVP scope (decision): EyesOn dashboard (single template), trace hooks with model/route/tenant tags + token_count, post-process cost-per-route pipeline, basic error-slice alerting. Owners: product=maria, eng=kevin, sres=tara, design=oliver, customer-eng=jess. Timeline: alpha in 6 weeks. Launch criteria:
  1) EyesOn dashboard usable with synthetic and pilot data
  2) Trace hooks live in pilot with sampling controls and <1% perf impact
  3) Cost-per-route calc matches billing within 5% for sample data
  4) Error-slice alerts firing for pilot customers and documented runbook
  5) Regression tests and perf guardrails in CI
kevin: +1, will add PR checklist and break into two-phase work: trace hooks + dashboard plumbing first, cost attribution second.
tara: :thumbsup: I'll own the canary docs and rollback thresholds.
oliver: mock ready by Wednesday; will include copy for in-product guidance and tooltip strings for sampling & cost estimator.
jess: I'll start customer comms and a pilot acceptance checklist (billing sign-off required).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag "lapwing-obs-alpha" created. Use ff/lapwing-obs-alpha to gate rollout.
maria: OK — if no major concerns I'm locking scope as above and will file the alpha RFC this afternoon. Please add any last constraints here.
eva: One constraint: limit trace payloads to metadata only; full traces stored for sampled errors only (storage limit). Noted.
kevin: Noted. I'll add sizing estimate for telemetry topic (expected retention 7d) to the RFC.
maria: Thanks all. Sync follow-up: Monday 10am to review mocks + canary doc. :coffee:
